	movement_cost = -0.38
	market_access = -0.25
	pop_movement = 0.35
	proximity = 8
	build_time_per_unit_distance = 22
	price_per_unit_distance = oe_build_via_imperialis
	construction_demand = oe_build_via_imperialis_demand
	maintenance_demand = maintain_paved_road_demand
	color = oe_via_imperialis
	spline_style_id = 1
	enabled = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		}
	}
	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_flv_first_via_imperialis }
			}
			set_variable = oe_flv_first_via_imperialis
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_flv.10
		}
	}
}
